'''Star Tours Flight 421''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight that traveled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and scheduled to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1K at 1505 hours. It was then scheduled to depart again at 1600.
